capabilities: Send the current note to Godspeed as a task
Send the section under the cursor's nearest heading
Send multiple selected files as separate tasks
Add extra text to the task title or notes
Store the Godspeed API key in Obsidian's secret storage
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer; the API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage so it does not travel with a synced or git-tracked vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push a note or heading into Godspeed as a linked task.

relations.evidence: It is the Obsidian version of the Godspeed browser extension and works the same way

summary: Task sender that sends the current note or section to Godspeed as a task containing an obsidian:// link back to it.
